title: ERC-8004 next to ERC-3643 and ONCHAINID
caption: Two identity models on Ethereum. ERC-3643 gates token transfers with issuer-signed claims on an ONCHAINID; ERC-8004 lets anyone mint an agent identity and collects open feedback. ERC-8226 (Draft) is the bridge standard that names both.
alt: Flowchart in two columns. Left, ERC-3643 plus ONCHAINID: a trusted issuer signs a claim on a holder ONCHAINID; the T-REX Identity Registry maps a wallet to that identity and a country; the Compliance contract checks canTransfer on each transfer; the Trusted Issuers Registry and Claim Topics Registry are set by the token owner. Right, ERC-8004: any address registers an agent in the Identity Registry; clients write feedback to the Reputation Registry; a reader filters by trusted clients. Mapping lines: trusted ClaimIssuer to trusted reviewer list; claim topics to feedback tags; Identity Registry to Identity Registry, same name, different thing. ERC-8226 connects a verified principal, a mandate and an ERC-8004 agent with ERC-3643 token compliance.
